name: run_id
doc: Identifier shared by every step of one orchestrator run; the same value is stamped as execution_id on the silver rows that run wrote

name: step_seq
doc: 1-based position of the step within its run

name: pipeline_name
doc: Orchestrator that produced the step (e.g. jepx_spot_price)

name: step_name
doc: Step within the pipeline (source_to_raw / raw_to_bronze / bronze_to_silver / silver_to_gold)

name: step_status
doc: success / skipped / failed. Named step_status because the injected audit column already takes 'status'

name: started_at
doc: When the step started; unset when a caller logged a result it did not time

name: ended_at
doc: When the step finished; unset when a caller logged a result it did not time

name: duration_seconds
doc: Wall-clock seconds between started_at and ended_at

name: expected_row_count
doc: Rows the step expected to move; unset for steps that move no rows (scraping / dbt)

name: actual_row_count
doc: Rows the step observed after writing; unset for steps that move no rows

name: target_scope
doc: What the run covered (e.g. fiscal_year=2026 or target_date=2026-08-21)

name: detail
doc: Human-readable step detail carried through from PipelineStepResult

name: logged_date
doc: Date the row was written. Partitioned by month rather than day: a run log gains a handful of rows a day and daily partitions would leave a year of near-empty files
